response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), all_colleges AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(c.record_count) AS average_count, AVG(c.record_count * 1.0 / a.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.record_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN all_colleges AS a WHERE c.record_count > a.average_count;
